name: Clarence
concept: The rules v12 starter: one of nearly every kind of move. Draft, from rules-overview 12. HP and speeds are placeholders, and the Super and eighth card are still to decide.
notes: Added 25 Oct 2026 as the first v12 fighter. HP 22 is a placeholder in the v11 roster's range. Tuning flags from the rules: chip on the Pressures is high (suggested trim Slash 3/1, Fireball 1/2, Dive 5/1: variant clarence-trim), Throw's knockdown timing (only if it beats a Recover: variant clarence-kd), and Block was first sketched at Cooldown 0.
